questions.q: When partners decide to maintain **fixed capital accounts**, where should a partner's share of profit, interest on capital, and drawings be recorded?
options: On the credit side of the Capital Account
On the debit side of the Capital Account
In the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account only
questions.explain: Under the **fixed capital system**, the Capital Account strictly records only initial capital contributions and permanent capital changes. All regular, fluctuating transactions such as drawings, share of profit, interest on capital, and salaries are recorded in a separate **Current Account**.
